entities.name: Gebhard of Salzburg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Blessed Gebhard von Salzburg, also occasionally known as Gebhard of Sussex, was Archbishop of Salzburg from 1060 until his death. He was one of the fiercest opponents of King Henry IV of Germany during the Investiture Controversy.
